query: SELECT v.id, v.name, v.sector, v.status, v.stage, COUNT(t.id) as task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_tasks FROM ventures v LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.ventureId = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.name, v.sector, v.status, v.stage ORDER BY v.name LIMIT 30;
